evals.name: every matched repository names its evidence
no fork is presented as the family's own project
every linked repository carries the world's own name, or an override with a stated reason
private repositories are flagged for exclusion from shareable pages
unassigned repositories are kept, not dropped

honesty: matches are read from repository names and descriptions; LINKED means the name carries the world's own name (or an override states why); CANDIDATE is the family's own work sharing domain words and waits on a steward; REFERENCE is a fork of someone else's work and is never presented as the family's own; private repositories never reach a shareable page
